charges.confirmCancelBody: “{concept}” for {name} stops counting as pending. You can reactivate it.

generate.title: Generate a period's charges
generate.description: Creates the period's charge for everyone the plan applies to. Anyone who already has it is skipped.
generate.planHint: {count, plural, one {Applies to # person} other {Applies to # people}} · {amount} each.
generate.periodLabelHint: How the period is named on the charge.
generate.noPlans: No active plans. Create one in the Plans tab.
generate.done: {created, plural, =0 {No new charges} one {# charge created} other {# charges created}}{skipped, plural, =0 {.} one { · # already existed.} other { · # already existed.}}

plans.caption: Fee plans
plans.emptyHint: A plan says how much and how often: the membership fee, a section's fee…

planSheet.title: New fee plan
planSheet.description: How much, how often and for whom. Charges are generated from the Charges tab.
planSheet.name: Name
planSheet.amountHint: In euros, with decimals if needed.
planSheet.targetHint: The whole club, one member type, or the athletes of a section.

payment.title: Record payment
payment.amountHint: Leave it empty to record everything pending ({pending}).

charge.title: New charge
charge.description: A one-off charge for a person, with or without a plan.
charge.descriptionFor: A charge for {name}, with or without a plan.
charge.personHint: Type at least two letters of the name or email.
charge.planHint: Optional. Fills in the concept and amount.

mine.title: My fees
mine.description: What you or your family owe the club, and what is already paid.
mine.owed: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing pending} one {Pending (# charge)} other {Pending (# charges)}}
mine.manualHint: The club records payments by hand: pay by bank transfer or at the office and it will show here as paid.
mine.loadError: Your fees could not be loaded.
mine.emptyHint: When the club issues you a charge, it shows up here.
mine.checkoutSuccess: Payment received. It may take a few seconds to show as paid.
mine.checkoutCancel: Payment cancelled. You can try again any time.
